profile.name: Ali Nikkhah
profile.headline: Machine Learning Engineer & Researcher — Agentic & Graph RAG, LLM GPU Serving, Vision-Language
profile.location: Tehran, Iran · Remote-friendly · Open to Relocation
profile.summary: ML engineer and researcher with 5+ years across industry and academia. Shipped Graph RAG for a national credit bureau, LLM pipelines serving 5M+ queries/day at marketplace scale, self-hosted vLLM/TGI GPU serving, a BNPL credit-risk ensemble (AUC 0.87), and vision-language research with an arXiv preprint in preparation. Sharif B.Sc. Electrical Engineering (GPA 3.65); M.Sc. Artificial Intelligence since Sep 2025.
profile.summary_brief: ML engineer/researcher — Graph RAG at a national credit bureau, 5M+ queries/day marketplace LLM pipelines, self-hosted LLM GPU serving, vision-language research.
profile.summary_detailed: ML engineer and researcher with 5+ years across industry and academia. Shipped agentic RAG platforms at marketplace scale (5M+ queries/day), a self-hosted Graph RAG assistant for a national credit bureau, and a BNPL credit-risk ensemble (AUC 0.87). Research spans vision-language ultrasound report generation (arXiv preprint in preparation), emotion-aware speech translation, texture-free motion classification, and LLM reasoning and hallucination mitigation. Sharif B.Sc. Electrical Engineering (GPA 3.65); M.Sc. Artificial Intelligence since Sep 2025. Self-hosts open-weight LLMs on GPU with AWQ/GPTQ quantization.

projects.title: Emotion-aware voice translation
projects.summary: Emotion-aware speech-to-speech translation system fusing SER transformer affect logits with wav2vec2.0/Whisper representations for prosody-consistent translation.
projects.description: Trained a transformer + wav2vec2.0/Whisper SER front-end to produce affect logits, then a cross-modal fusion transformer for emotion-consistent decoding. Curated emotion-annotated corpora (EmotionNet, EmoDB) with balanced cultural representation and evaluated BLEU, Emotion F1, and MOS. Collaboration with Prof. Siobhán Clarke; reproducible codebase on GitHub.

projects.title: Ultrasound report generation
projects.summary: Vision-language system generating DICOM-compliant ultrasound reports via contrastive vision-language learning with clinician-facing interpretability.
projects.description: Designed ViT/BLIP encoders with T5 generation and contrastive/self-supervised alignment over curated DICOM and de-identified QA corpora. Deployed attention and saliency overlays and benchmarked BLEU/ROUGE-L plus clinical efficacy with radiologists, reaching state-of-the-art on the in-house split. Preprint in preparation for arXiv.

projects.title: Texture-free motion intelligence
projects.summary: Texture-free human motion classification via optical flow and 3D CNN–transformer hybrids, benchmarked on UCF-101 and HMDB-51.
projects.description: Engineered optical-flow-centric datasets with temporal sampling and augmentation to improve domain generalization under lighting, texture, and camera shift. Benchmarked 3D CNN and transformer hybrids against baselines, analyzed attention maps, and achieved state-of-the-art accuracy on UCF-101/HMDB-51.
